method: Frozen independent scalar WGS84 Mercator closed form; UTM33 central-meridian meridional-arc series through e6. No Tegola/proj encoder, decoder, CRS resolver or transformation called.
tolerance_reason: Bound chosen before runtime; degrees ~0.11m, UTM truncated-series residual smaller than 0.15m. Axis order and Z require exact coordinate placement, not a tolerance exemption.
bbox_membership_policy: Each fixture request supplies literal bbox in that CRS frame; verify exact returned geometry membership in that rectangle before paging. No equality of feature ID lists across different projected rectangles. Absent geometry matches bbox under Core absence semantics.
